'''Yelsain''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].

==Description==
Yelsain was a forest planet home to massive [[Tree/Legends|trees]], some as tall as 400 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Despite its very high volume its gravity was lower than average due to the almost complete absence of [[Metal/Legends|metals]] in the planet's crust. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was high in [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], creating the spectacular weather for which Yelsain was famous, with immense thunderstorms occurring practically every night affair. The animals which inhabited Yelsain were extremely large, averaging twice the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]], and the [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] were considered very dangerous. The two most dangerous creatures were the [[Troglith]]s and the [[Garath]]s.<ref name="GG6" />

==Society==
Almost all the settlers live high off the ground, in houses built in the gigantic trees of the northen continent, for the [[Yelsain's southern islands|southern isands]] are often struck by tremendous [[Hurricane/Legends|hurricanes]] and are populated by dangerous wildlife. Most communities are built up in the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] as well, with [[Wood/Legends|wood]] and [[Rope/Legends|rope]] pathways linking the branches to one another to avoid the dangerous creatures that live at ground level. The [[University/Legends|universities]] of Yelsain, considered the best in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], are also built high up in the trees.<ref name="GG6" />

Despite making use of high tech items such as [[Comlink/Legends|communicators]], [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorlift vehicles]] and advanced medical techniques, the majority of [[Yelsainian|Yelsainians]] are [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] who commonly till their fields with animals pulling rudimentary plows; the population had made the conscious choice to live in contact with the natural world, avoiding using metal and [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] whenever possible while having an almost religious reverence for wood. On Yelsain, even the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] were built of wood as much as possible.<ref name="GG6" />

Yelsain had no governmental body and its constitution prohibited the creation of one, leading to an absence of both taxes and government officials. Despite the freedom granted to its citiziens the planet Yelsain was largely free of crime, with disputes being solved with duels and justice being carried out by improvised courts made up of armed settlers craving for justice. The worst crimes in yelsanian society were, in decreasing order of severity: murder, rape, armed assault, pollution and theft, with murder being allowed if resulting from a fair fight. Punishments of offenses ranged from beatings to one-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]'s hard labor on somebody's [[Farm/Legends|farm]], to banishment on one of the southern islands alone and unarmed or to outright [[Death penalty/Legends|execution]].<ref name="GG6" />

Due to the high level of oxygen offworlders tended to become dizzy at first, particularly when they exerted themselves. However, they did not get as winded as they normally would.<ref name="GG6" />

==History==
The planet was first colonized sometime after [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]] by [[Adarlonian|Adarlonians]] which, fearing the modern life on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] was making them too detached from nature, decided to search for a planet where they could've lived a more rural lifestyle far from the chaos of the [[City/Legends|cities]]. Yelsain's close connections with Adarlon led to make the planet a favourite topic for [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]], with many of them depicting the early settlers fighting off [[Troglith|Trogliths]] and [[Garath|Garaths]] and the adventures of the brash Yelsain [[Tree-ranger|tree-rangers]]. The yelsanians have grown to hate this popularity, often reacting badly when asked about tree-rangers by tourists.<ref name="GG6" />

During the last couple hundred years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], Yelsain was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi knights]]. A huge number of young men and women also used to volunteer to join the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], considering it a way to repay the Republic for having helped found the colony and having kept the peace ever since.<ref name="GG6" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the population suffered systematic denial of basic rights<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and was vehemently and openly anti-Imperial.<ref name="GG6" /> Despite it being technically under direct Imperial control due to its refusal to pay taxes during the [[Yelsainian anti-tax insurrection]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had only imposed a 20% tax on all incoming and outgoing trade proucts, having found it to be more cost-effective than maintaining a presence on the planet.<ref name="GG6" />
